ctx.x: Let's see, Leo played banjo. Jules played bass and trombone and maybe piano.

Jules played most everything. Anything. He played piano too. He told us he rolled on the floor with the bass one night because he didn't know how to play it and he just hammed it up. And then Joe played guitar and sang. Bertie played piano. And Roni played piano. That's Raymond's mother. My mother didn't play in musical instruments. And the grandfather was the one who played in the French opera. He played French horn and violin and hornet, I believe. They used to have a party just when they'd get together.
Oh, yeah. But Raymond was a barrier also, isn't it?
